column2: Reload to finish switching to the new profile.
Remind you to grab a Healthstone when a Warlock is in your group. Warlocks get a click-to-cast Create Healthstone reminder.
Reminder names, item counts and the mana warning
Reminds you when the Camp Benefits campfire buff is missing.
Reminds you whenever this buff is missing. Remove stops tracking it.
Remove a character's saved bags, bank and gold from the account cache. The character you are logged in on is recorded again automatically and cannot be deleted.
Remove the stranded '%s' override for %s? The spec returns to the shared default.
Removes the color codes the plugin writes into its own text, so this block's Text Color applies. Off keeps the plugin's colors.
Removes this block from the bar.
Rename this bar. Press Enter to apply.
Repairs from the guild bank when your withdraw limit covers the cost, otherwise from your own gold.
Replace Blizzard's split popup for bag and bank items with the split dialog that also offers Auto Split.
Replaces the class icon with the strongest stun, silence, fear, root or immunity on that enemy.
Replaces the difficulty flag with a compact readout such as 25H.
Replaces the stock player cast bar.
Reposition this element within Unlock Mode
Requires a client with gliding events.
Requires Power Type: Mana + Form Power.
Requires Show Player. Party frames hide while in a raid.

Rescue tool for a profile built inside an override: the selected group's settings and layouts become this profile's own baseline, then ALL spec override groups are deleted. Conditional overrides are not affected.
Reset failed - there are still players inside the instance.
Resource amounts are separated by power type.
Resource, cast and GCD bar textures
Restore Default Assignments For This Bar
Restyles the game's chat bubbles and turns them on for the checked channels.
Retail border styles from the shared border catalogue.
Reveal on hover only. Combines with the conditions below: hover-reveals while they all pass, stays hidden while any fails.
Right click: back from details, or open meter bookmarks.
Same setup, same EllesmereUI features, a new look: switch to Blizzard Style or the new Classic WoW UI in one click, and switch back any time.
Saved for this character only. Type a spell ID and press Enter to be reminded whenever that buff is missing on you.\nSpells in your spellbook are click-to-cast. Unknown IDs are ignored.
Saved for this raid layout. Hidden groups leave no empty space.
Say, Yell and numbered channels such as General, Trade and World. Scopes repeat, keyword, trade ad and recruitment filters.
Scales the size of Blizzard's default game text (menus, tooltips, quest log, and more). Requires a UI reload.
Scales the stock bar; 30 is its normal size.
Scales the text size of Blizzard tooltips.
Scales the whole frame. Blizzard Style frames are the stock size, so this stands in for Bar Width and Health Bar Height.
Screen layer this bar renders on. Raise it to draw over other frames, lower it to sit behind them.
Scroll the mouse wheel over a vendor window to turn its item pages.
Seconds to show the active state after a cast, for spells without a buff.
Separate words or phrases with commas or semicolons. Case insensitive, including accented letters, literal substring matching. Empty entries are ignored.
Set a glow once. Apply to All changes the active custom glows listed below.

Sets the font for the names that float above players, NPCs and enemies in the world.

Separate from Global Font - changing this does not affect the rest of the UI, and Global Font does not affect it.

Blizzard Default leaves the name text completely untouched.

Settings Overrides are the most powerful system in EllesmereUI, and the deepest. A few minutes with this video will save you hours of working it out on your own.
Shift while resizing locks one direction
Shift+Middle Click to always show all settings
Shift-drag the icons to move them
Show a glow on the cast bar when the unit is casting a spell Blizzard marks as important.

Show a reminder when you don't have an active pet summoned. Only applies to pet classes (Hunter, Warlock, Unholy Death Knight).\nHunters: right-click switches between Call Pet and Revive Pet. Warlocks: right-click cycles demons.
Show a reminder when your active pet is set to Passive stance. Clicking sets it to Defensive.
Show aura tooltips when hovering buff and debuff icons on all unit frames except boss frames.
Show aura tooltips when hovering buff and debuff icons on boss frames.
Show copies of the same item in separate slots as one icon with their counts added together. Paused while the mail, trade, auction house, bank or guild bank window is open.
Show Dispellable When No Boss Debuff
Show Enchant Names Instead of Icons
Show every buff that has a duration (hides permanent buffs). Use the Hide lane below to remove specific filters.
Show every buff. Use the Hide lane below to remove specific filters.
Show every debuff. Use the Hide lane below to remove specific filters.
Show how many of the consumable you have left in your bags.
Show item or spell tooltips when hovering reminder icons.
Show one sub-category per equipment set (named after the set) under Item Set Gear.
Show reminders when remaining buff time is below this many minutes.\n0 = only when fully expired.\nIgnored in combat (then only when the buff is gone).
Show the border style and size controls for the cast bar.
Show the equipped bag slots above the window (also toggled by the Bags header button).
Show the friends and flyout buttons only while the map is hovered.
Show the keyring in the bag window.
Show the pet frame whenever you have a pet, ignoring the Player frame's visibility settings.
Show the unit's tooltip when hovering the frame itself.
Showing the '%s' override's value. Edit it from that override's editing mode.
Showing this aura from any caster; click for your casts only.
Showing this aura from your casts only; click for any caster.
Shown at max level. Header shows GearScore.
Shown on dead members being resurrected (LibResComm-1.0, bundled).
Shows a house or globe icon marking which latency each value is.
Shows a small white tick mark where the cast will be when your interrupt comes off cooldown.
Shows debuffs that match any checked Show filter (the default).
Shows every bar with placeholder icons while the options are open.
Shows every debuff on this frame.
Shows incoming heals past the health bar: yours, then other players'.
Shows large amounts using K/M suffixes (284,208g becomes 284.2Kg) instead of the full grouped number. The tooltip always shows the exact amount.
Shows only debuffs Blizzard flags as important.
Shows only debuffs that match every checked Show filter (dispel types count as one); opposites like Non-Player Auras with Cast By You show nothing.
Shows only the debuffs you apply that Blizzard also flags as important.
Shows only the debuffs you apply.
Shows only this frame's Tracked Auras; add them with Edit Tracked Auras at the top of this menu.
Shows the audio icon next to the volume bar.
Shows the bag icon next to the slot count.
Shows the combat status text only while your character is in combat.
Shows the cost of the spell being cast on the power bar.
Shows the currency's description text in the tooltip. Turn off for a compact tooltip with just the name and the amount.
Shows the debuffs you apply plus important debuffs from anyone.
Shows the frame while this unit is below full health; while enabled, a frame hidden by its visibility setting can still be clicked.
Shows the health text elements placed in Core Text Positions.
Shows the last lines of each chat window again after a reload or relog.
Shows the most important boss debuff (ICC, Ruby Sanctum, ToC, Ulduar, Naxxramas) as a large icon in the middle of the frame.
Shows the network latency zone at the end of casts or channels, including queued spells.
Shows the overlay only for debuffs you can currently dispel.
Shows the plugin's own icon next to its text.
Shows the plugin's text. Off leaves an icon-only block that still carries the plugin's tooltip and clicks.
Shows the profession icons next to the text.
Shows the spec icon next to the text.
Shows the spell icon over the portrait while casting and lets the bar use the full width.
Shows the stock rune or combo point frame here instead of the pips.
Shows the unit's level in the frame's level circle, as the default UI does.
Shows your arena opponents. Left click targets, right click sets focus.
Shows your hunter pet's happiness beside the pet frame.
Shows your interrupt while your focus is casting.
Shows your interrupt while your focus or target is casting.
Shows your threat percentage on the target and focus frames while you are in combat with that unit.
Size matching is unavailable with Blizzard Style Unit Frames.
Size of the Classic frame around the bar.
Size of the Classic WoW UI frame when the classic style is on.
Size of the dragon, as a percent of its fit around the portrait.
Size of the outer ring relative to the portrait.
Sizes the movement alert's free text, bar number and icon countdown. Switching the alert's Display Mode re-seeds this value.
Slowly orbits the checked elements while Party Mode is active; they stay upright and pause in combat.
Spell icons show your own short buff from that spell instead of the cooldown.
Spell ID of the interrupt to show. 0 uses your class interrupt.
Spell ID unavailable in this client
Spell names appear on identified target and mouseover plates.
Split bank items by category, using the same category list, order and renames as the All Items bag view.
Square dark skins for Wrath windows, tooltips, menus and popups.
Stances, forms and stealth keep Action Bar 1 on its own page.
Starter layout for the next bar you create.
Starts the tab strip at the sidebar edge.
